name: EP12 Photo from site -> line-itemed quote draft (human approval gate, no send step, 12 nodes)

nodes.name: Site photo in
nodes.notes: POST a photo URL plus the note the lad on site typed. Demo payload in README (sample-site-photo.json).

nodes.name: Read the photo and the note
nodes.notes: Normalises any INBOUND intake shape (a web form, an email-to-webhook parser, a WhatsApp-to-webhook bridge) to one flat item. Refuses a non-https photo. Mints the quote_ref. Field names avoid the n8n sandbox blacklist (no 'caller').

nodes.name: Load the rate card
nodes.notes: YOUR prices, in YOUR table. ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE PRICES SHIP WITH THIS EPISODE (rate-card-sample.csv) - they are made up for the demo and must be replaced with your own before you quote anybody.

nodes.name: Build the vision request
nodes.notes: Builds one chat-completions body: the photo, the site note, and the catalogue of item_codes. The model is never shown a price, so it can never change one.

nodes.name: Vision model reads the photo

httpHeaderAuth.name: REPLACE_ME - vision endpoint (Header Auth: Authorization / Bearer ...)

nodes.notes: Any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint. onError=continue on purpose: a dead model must still produce a draft the human sees flagged, never a silent nothing.

nodes.name: Price it against the rate card
nodes.notes: The model picked item_codes and quantities. THIS node supplies every price, from the Data Table. An invented code is dropped and flagged, never priced.

nodes.name: Queue the draft for approval
nodes.notes: The draft lands in ep12_quote_queue as approval_status = awaiting_human_approval. This table IS the approval inbox.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, quote_ref: $json.quote_ref, approval_status: $json.approval_status, line_count: $json.line_count, currency_code: $json.currency_code, total_amount: $json.total_amount, flags: $json.unmatched_note, release_mode: $json.release_mode, approve_url: $execution.resumeUrl + '?decision=approve', hold_url: $execution.resumeUrl + '?decision=hold', quote_summary: $json.quote_summary }) }}

nodes.name: Reply with the draft + approval links
nodes.notes: Hands back the draft AND the two one-click links for the human. $execution.resumeUrl must be read BEFORE the Wait node, which is why this node sits here.

nodes.name: APPROVAL GATE - wait for a human
nodes.notes: THE GATE. The execution stops dead here and stays stopped until a person opens approve_url or hold_url. Nothing downstream can run on its own, on a timer, or on a retry.

nodes.name: Did the human approve it?
nodes.notes: Fails closed: anything that is not the literal string 'approve' - a blank click, a stray retry, a typo - takes the HOLD branch.

value.release_mode: APPROVED BY A HUMAN - this workflow still sends nothing. Sending is your own action, outside this file.

nodes.name: Approved - the human said yes (still nothing sent)
nodes.notes: TERMINAL. Marks the row approved and the workflow ends. There is no send node here or anywhere on this canvas - sending the approved quote is your own action, taken by you, outside this file.

value.release_mode: HELD BY A HUMAN - the draft stays in the table and goes nowhere.

nodes.name: Held - the human said no
nodes.notes: TERMINAL. The draft stays in the table for the human to rewrite. A held quote is still a logged job - it is not deleted, and it was never sent.

main.node: Read the photo and the note
Price it against the rate card
Reply with the draft + approval links
APPROVAL GATE - wait for a human
Approved - the human said yes (still nothing sent)
